identities.name: Cascade Brewery
identities.address: 131 Cascade Road, South Hobart, Tasmania, Australia

mapIdentity.scope: The east facade and road alignment come from the current OpenStreetMap footprint. The period photographs and state building descriptions control the vertical steps and the scale of connecting historic ranges.

note: The Beattie postcard shows three lower floors, sandstone courses and lower arched windows. The May 1937 public-domain newspaper photograph shows the added upper brewery and lettering. The heritage register describes the seven-level envelope, 1967 damage and low attached ranges.
